{{Quote|All the above are mind-relaxing, to say the least.|Ebenn Q3 Baobab describes Gardulla in his book|<ref name="GPBATG" />}}
'''Gardulla''' was a beverage that was favored by members of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Species/Legends|species]] during the [[Post-Imperial era/Legends|reign]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]],<ref name="GPBATG" /> sharing its name with the Hutts [[Gardulla Besadii the Elder]]<ref name="S&V">[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref> and [[Gardulla Besadii the Younger|Gardulla the Younger]].<ref name="AoC2">''[[The New Jedi Order: Agents of Chaos II: Jedi Eclipse]]''</ref> [[Human/Legends|Human]] scholar [[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]]'s [[Book/Legends|book]] ''[[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide]]'', which was written in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]], suggested that readers try the drink when visiting any Huttese [[Restaurant/Legends|eateries]] in the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. He described the drink as mind-relaxing and listed it among his favorite Huttese [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] and drink in the [[Huttese/Legends|Huttese]] [[Language/Legends|language]] section of his guide.<ref name="GPBATG" /> The beverage was also served in heavy pitchers at a huge feast held by [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]] the Hutt at his [[Popara's penthouse|penthouse]] on the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]]<ref name="Sc" /> in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].<ref name="ERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']] to [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The beverage Gardulla was first mentioned in the [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']], a [[2001]] book written by [[Ben Burtt]].<ref name="GPBATG" /> It later appeared in the novel [[Scourge (novel)|''Scourge'']], which was written by [[Jeff Grubb]] an released in [[2012]]. The book was a novelized version<ref name="Sc" /> of the [[Wizards of the Coast]] ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' adventure ''[[Tempest Feud]]'', although the beverage is not mentioned in the original RPG material.<ref name="Tempest">''[[Tempest Feud]]''</ref>
